findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization - YAML and pickle
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle, yaml.load, or other unsafe methods
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization-httpx
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember("loads").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization via pickle, yaml.load, or other unsafe methods

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

/**
 * @name Insecure SSL/TLS configuration
 * @description Using insecure SSL/TLS settings can lead to man-in-the-middle attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/insecure-ssl
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("httpx").getMember("Client").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("create_default_context").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_unverified_context").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("SSLContext").getACall()
select call, "SSL/TLS context creation - check for insecure configurations (verify=False or unverified contexts)"
findings.hypothesis: Insecure SSL/TLS configuration allowing unverified connections
